title: Rows per tenant in a synthetic dataset
method: Generate 100 small tenants × 100 rows and 1 large tenant × 100,000 rows: 110,000 total. The large tenant holds 100,000/110,000 ≈ 90.9%. Row counts illustrate skew and do not predict query latency.
alt: Rows per tenant in a synthetic dataset. Small tenant: 100 orders; Large tenant: 100000 orders. Illustrative inputs.
